description: Restore plugin states to exactly match a previously saved snapshot.

snapshot.description: A snapshot dict as returned by :meth:`save_snapshot`, containing at minimum a ``"plugins"`` key with a list of ``folderName`` values for the plugins that should be enabled. All other plugins will be disabled.

bulk.description: When ``True`` (default), all enable and disable changes are sent in a single PATCH request. When ``False``, one PATCH request is made per plugin change.

description: Capture the current plugin enable/disable state as a snapshot.
